title: Four killed in firefight between Cuban coastguard and Florida-registered speedboat
summary: Four people were killed ​and at least six others were wounded on Wednesday when a speedboat travelling from Florida entered Cuba's territorial waters and opened ​fire ‌on the Cuban coastguard, who returned ⁠fire, according to the interior ministry.
contentText: A confrontation in Cuban waters left four people dead on Wednesday after soldiers opened fire on a Florida-registered speedboat that Havana says attacked first. Washington is investigating whether any victims were US citizens, as the incident threatens to deepen already strained relations between the two countries.
